description: Type stub file for torch._C._functorch, defining function signatures, classes, and enums related to functorch's internals and dynamic layer management.

classes.name: TransformType
classes.description: Enum representing different transformation types such as Torch, Vmap, Grad, Jvp, and Functionalize.

classes.name: RandomnessType
classes.description: Enum representing types of randomness: Error, Same, and Different.

classes.name: CInterpreter
classes.description: Class representing a C++ interpreter with methods to get its key, level, serialize/deserialize.

classes.name: CGradInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer-like class wrapping a CInterpreter for gradient transformations, with methods to lift tensors and get previous gradient mode.

classes.name: CJvpInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer-like class wrapping a CInterpreter for JVP transformations, with methods to lift tensors and get previous forward gradient mode.

classes.name: CFunctionalizeInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer-like class wrapping a CInterpreter for functionalization, with methods to get key, level, and functionalize add back views setting.

classes.name: CVmapInterpreterPtr
classes.description: Pointer-like class wrapping a CInterpreter for vmap transformations, with methods for key, level, batch size, and randomness.

classes.name: DynamicLayer
classes.description: Placeholder class representing a dynamic layer in the stack.

methods.name: set_inplace_requires_grad_allowed
methods.description: Set whether in-place operations are allowed to require gradient.

methods.name: get_inplace_requires_grad_allowed
methods.description: Get whether in-place requires grad is allowed.

methods.name: _set_dynamic_layer_keys_included
methods.description: Set whether dynamic layer keys are included.

methods.name: is_batchedtensor
methods.description: Check if a tensor is a batched tensor.

methods.name: is_functionaltensor
methods.description: Check if a tensor is a functional tensor.

methods.name: is_functorch_wrapped_tensor
methods.description: Check if a tensor is wrapped by functorch.

methods.name: is_gradtrackingtensor
methods.description: Check if a tensor tracks gradients.

methods.name: is_legacy_batchedtensor
methods.description: Check if a tensor is a legacy batched tensor.

methods.name: unwrap_if_dead
methods.description: Unwrap tensor if it is dead.

methods.name: _unwrap_batched
methods.description: Unwrap batched tensor, returning tensor and level.

methods.name: set_single_level_autograd_function_allowed
methods.description: Allow or disallow autograd functions at a single level.

methods.name: get_single_level_autograd_function_allowed
methods.description: Check if autograd functions at single level are allowed.

methods.name: get_dynamic_layer_stack_depth
methods.description: Get current stack depth of dynamic layers.

methods.name: get_interpreter_stack
methods.description: Retrieve the current stack of interpreters.

methods.name: peek_interpreter_stack
methods.description: Peek at the top interpreter without removing.

methods.name: pop_dynamic_layer_stack_and_undo_to_depth
methods.description: Undo dynamic layers to a specified depth.

methods.name: push_dynamic_layer_stack
methods.description: Push a new dynamic layer onto the stack.
